description: This file defines the TransactionManagerExtension class, which implements ITransactionManagerExtension. It manages transaction managers for different resources, providing methods for pinging, preparing, committing, and marking transactions as prepared within the Orleans distributed transaction framework.

classes.name: TransactionManagerExtension
classes.description: Implements ITransactionManagerExtension, managing transaction managers for resources within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: TransactionManagerExtension
methods.description: Constructor that initializes resource factories and manager dictionary using the provided context accessor.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to the transaction manager for a specific resource.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction across specified resources.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Marks a transaction as prepared for a specific resource.

methods.name: GetManager
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a transaction manager for a given resource ID.
